title: Organic Chemistry II
description: A second-semester organic chemistry course covering aromaticity and electrophilic aromatic substitution, carbonyl chemistry, carboxylic acids and derivatives, amines, enolate and condensation reactions, multistep synthesis, mass spectrometry and integrated spectroscopy, and organic chemistry of biomolecules.
